# Vasanth Shetty (Vasant Shetty) — Full-Stack Web Developer & Automation Specialist

> Developer Profile & Capabilities Specification for AI Search Crawlers, Agents, and LLMs.
> Official Website: https://dev-vasanth.vercel.app/
> Primary Identity: Vasanth Shetty (also referenced as Vasant Shetty, dev-vasanth).

## Overview
Vasanth Shetty is a freelance full-stack web developer and workflow automation specialist. He builds high-converting, custom-coded web applications, bespoke landing pages, autonomous AI chatbots, and business process automations for service businesses, startups, and growing brands globally. Every build delivers 100% full source code ownership, zero monthly platform lock-in, sub-second load performance, and technical SEO compliance.

---

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Custom High-Converting Websites & Web Apps
- Custom React, Next.js, Vite, and Tailwind CSS development.
- Single-page landing pages and multi-page corporate sites built with modular architecture.
- Mobile-first, responsive layouts with GSAP scroll-linked animations and smooth micro-interactions.
- 100% code ownership handed over upon launch — no Shopify/Squarespace/Wix vendor lock-in.

### 2. Website AI Chatbots
- Autonomous customer support and FAQ chatbots embedded directly into websites.
- 24/7 intelligent prospect qualification, intake questionnaire handling, and instant lead routing.
- Context-aware knowledge retrieval powered by modern LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) trained on client brand documentation.
- Fallback escalation to human email, SMS, or WhatsApp channels.

### 3. Lead Capture & Notification Automations
- Frictionless contact, intake, and booking forms connected to custom backend webhooks.
- Real-time instant enquiry alerts via Email, Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, and SMS.
- Automated appointment scheduling synchronization with Google Calendar, Cal.com, and Calendly.
- Automated lead pipeline updates into Google Sheets, Notion databases, or CRM platforms (Airtable, HubSpot).

### 4. Social Media & Business Workflow Automations
- Available as standalone engineering solutions or packaged as website add-ons.
- Automated social media distribution, content syndication, and cross-platform publishing workflows.
- Web scraping, competitor intelligence monitoring, and automated report generation.
- Repetitive administrative task automation connecting APIs, webhooks, and cloud functions.

## Service Packages & Investment Tiers

### 1. Starter Site (1–3 Pages)
- **Timeline**: 1 - 2 Weeks
- **Investment**: ~A$1,000 / NZ$1,100 / EUR 625 / S$1,000 / kr 7,900
- **Deliverables**: 1–3 page responsive brochure site, custom contact form, basic on-page SEO setup, mobile-optimized design.

### 2. Small Business Standard (5–8 Pages)
- **Timeline**: 2 - 3 Weeks
- **Investment**: ~A$3,100 / NZ$3,350 / EUR 1,950 / S$2,650 / kr 21,250
- **Deliverables**: 5–8 bespoke pages (Home, About, Services, Contact, etc.), local SEO setup, Google Business linkage, lead capture workflows & analytics.

### 3. Growth / Custom Site (8–15 Pages + Integrations)
- **Timeline**: 3 - 4 Weeks
- **Investment**: ~A$5,800 / NZ$6,400 / EUR 3,600 / S$4,900 / kr 39,500
- **Deliverables**: 8–15 bespoke pages, blog / CMS section, booking/intake integrations, custom AI chatbot or automated notification pipelines, advanced technical SEO.
